uncertain: total_required_credits is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all groups (using the lower bound for credit ranges such as 4-6, 0-3).
Students taking the program as first major are exempted from the School Requirements (see PDF preamble).
Several blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. MATH blocks, capstone alternatives, ECON 2103/2113), so the actual credits taken by a student may differ from the calculated total.
The ECON 4000-level or above Electives group (8 credits, at least 2 courses) does not have a specific course list in the PDF, so its courses array is empty.
Remarks in the PDF note that LIFS 1030 was last offered in 2020-21 and deleted subsequently; it is kept in the list as printed in the PDF.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 MAEC (4Y) (2025-26 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2025-26 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2025-26 per the intake year.
